address: Av. Isaac Newton 256, Polanco, Miguel Hildalgo, 11560, Mexico
bio: Chefs Karina Mejía and Israel Montero opened this modern taqueria in Polanco in 2019. Located just a few doors down from their full sit-down restaurant, Siembra Comedor, this sidewalk hotspot shells out a wide variety of tacos built on heirloom corn tortillas and quality proteins. Fish al pastor boasts wonderfully charred spices while the arrachera feels like a play on steak frites thanks to the crispy, shoestring potatoes on top. The kitchen works quickly, and tacos are ample in size....
